summary: Banco Santander filed a Form 6-K announcing receipt of Federal Reserve approval to complete its acquisition of Webster Financial Corporation, following prior approvals from the OCC and ECB. The acquisition terms were previously disclosed; this filing updates the regulatory timeline. Completion is expected on 20 August 2026. The board recommendation and advisors from prior notices are referenced but not detailed here. The deal remains subject to closing conditions; watch for completion and integration risks.
